summary: Skeena Resources filed a material change report on Form 6-K detailing the completion of a US$750M senior secured notes offering due 2031, with an 8.500% coupon and two-year non-call period. Proceeds will be used to repurchase 66.67% of an existing gold stream for US$184M, prefund 18 months of interest, and support construction at the Eskay Creek project. The company also cancelled its undrawn US$350M senior secured loan and cost overrun facility without penalty. This refinancing enhances the balance sheet but is not an acquisition, spin-off, or activist campaign. The filing is a foreign private issuer report under Rule 13a-16, analogous to a US Form 8-K disclosure of a material definitive agreement.
